{{Quote|This is Starfall leader calling Imperial shuttle. As everything you told us seems to be correct, including the recent destruction of ''Subjugator'', please feel free to come aboard our flagship as personal guests of the Alliance.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Torrie]]|<ref name="SF">[[Starfall (adventure)|''Starfall'']]</ref>}}
A '''command shuttle''' was part of the complement of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] assigned to the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']]. It was readied on the order of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kolaff]] to transport him to safety, but was commandeered by [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] and a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents to escape the [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
